edits.value_json: The character is currently used for ‘tree’. CUHK reports an oracle-bone phrase 埶(藝)木 and interprets it as planting trees; because the rubbing was not checked, this report does not establish an attested historical tree sense. The phrase also does not establish that ‘tree’ predates the wood or board use.
